name: screen-pulse
description: Manage your Screen Pulse TV screens and AI menu boards from ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: TV menu screens and AI menus
interface.longDescription: Screen Pulse lets restaurant owners run their in-store TV screens from ChatGPT. Check which screens are online, see what each one is showing, restart or rename a screen, put a template, Canva design or AI menu on your TVs, create and update schedules, and design new menu boards in Screen Pulse AI Menu Studio. Sign in with your Screen Pulse account. Every change to your screens or schedules is shown to you first and only runs after you approve it on a Screen Pulse page.
